reported.title: Pressure conversion omits 500 mV zero offset
reported.description: millivoltsToKpa() at line 25 divides mv by MV_PER_KPA without subtracting the 500 mV zero offset, so every reading is inflated by 50 kPa. Measured evidence shows printed 159.3 kPa against injected 106.5 to 114.2 kPa, and printed 63 kPa against injected 8.9 to 14.7 kPa, off by ~48 kPa. The conversion must be (mv - 500) / 10. Firmware printed 162.3 kPa at 5.01 s while the injected input was 105.88 to 114.46 kPa: off by 47.8 kPa (tolerance ±2). 10 of 10 values were wrong.

reported.title: Gauge lamp driven from offset-corrupted pressure
reported.description: updateGauge() at line 42 compares lastKpa against WARN_KPA, but lastKpa comes from the offset-less conversion at line 70, so the lamp lights at roughly 400 mV (~-10 kPa physical) instead of 1400 mV (90 kPa). Measured evidence shows D12 not LOW for 1899 ms while required and not LOW for 719 ms during a nominal ramp. Fixing the offset in millivoltsToKpa() corrects the threshold comparison. D12 was in the wrong state for 1411 ms across 3 interval(s), first at 1.53 s: D12 was not LOW for 471 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

judge_input.spec:
- Pressure transducer on A2 scaled at 10 mV/kPa with a 500 mV zero offset; high-pressure gauge lamp on D12.
- Physical pressure in kPa equals (millivolts − 500) / 10 using a 5.000 V / 1023 ADC span.
- Emit `kPa: <value>` once every 1000 ms with one decimal place.
- Printed pressure must match the injected value within ±2.0 kPa.
- Drive D12 HIGH when pressure is at or above 90.0 kPa; otherwise LOW.
- Continue logging at the same rate while the gauge lamp is lit.
